item.title: Waymo’s backers valued it at $126 billion. The Alphabet division that houses it brought in $372 million last quarter—and lost $2.05 billion
item.description: Other Bets lost $5.50 for every $1 of revenue in Q3 2026.

item.title: Florida has 162 measles cases reported and no dashboard — so it’s considering dropping 4 school vaccine requirements
item.description: Only 88.9% of Florida kindergartners got the MMR vaccine in the 2025-26 school year, below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity.

item.title: Greenland opens a new international airport to lure tourists and diversify its economy as it eyes independence from Denmark
item.description: Ilulissat, known as the “City of Icebergs,” sits along the island's western coast and is home to some 5,000 people.
